butcher-charts.title: Vintage Butcher Chart Prints (10 Meat Cut Guide Posters)
butcher-charts.description: Vintage-style butcher charts showing where every cut comes from — duck, turkey, goat, venison, rabbit, salmon, tuna, lobster, crab and octopus. Each print pairs a full-body illustration with labelled cuts and clean pointer lines, in the muted palette of an old butcher's shop poster. For kitchens, butcher counters, restaurant walls, and anyone who cooks seriously. High resolution, no watermark, prints at A4 or Letter.

great-minds.title: Great Minds Educational Posters (10 Fields of Achievement)
great-minds.description: Ten illustrated posters, each grouping the figures who shaped one field — mathematicians, inventors, explorers, architects, poets, astronomers, physicians, naturalists, economists and playwrights. Portraits, dates, and a short line on what each is known for. Built as a classroom or study-wall reference rather than decoration alone. No watermark, prints at A4 or Letter.

confusing-english-words.title: Commonly Confused English Words (10 Grammar Study Posters)
confusing-english-words.description: Ten posters covering the word pairs that trip up native speakers and learners alike — then vs than, lay vs lie, fewer vs less, who vs whom, farther vs further, principal vs principle, stationary vs stationery, bring vs take, imply vs infer, historic vs historical. Each gives both definitions, a worked example, and a memory trick. For ESL classrooms, English tutors, and writers' walls. No watermark, A4/Letter.

dessert-color-lab.title: Dessert Colour Lab Prints (10 Patisserie Kitchen Posters)
dessert-color-lab.description: Ten prints, each a nine-dessert grid built around a single colour story — blush pink, chocolate brown, citrus orange, matcha green, lavender, midnight black, caramel gold, berry wine, cream and ivory, turquoise mint. Every dessert is shot against its own matched background and named beneath. Equal parts colour study and patisserie menu. For kitchens, bakery walls, and food-styling reference. No watermark, A4/Letter.
